    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, Graco is recalling specific SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seat bases due to a structural defect discovered during post-production testing. Affected models were sold between January and March 2026 at major retailers, including Amazon, Target, and Walmart. 
    What to Do Immediately: 
    • Stop using the base: Do not use the base of the recalled SnugRide Turn & Slide car seats.
    • Safe to use car seat alone: You can continue to use the infant car seat without the base, following the instruction manual.
    • Locate Model Information: Find your model number and serial number on the white sticker on the base.
    • Check and Register: Verify if your product is included and register for a free replacement base on the Graco Recall Website. 
    Affected Products: 
    • Model: SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats.
    • Manufacture Dates: January 2026 – March 2026. 
    If you have questions, contact Graco Consumer Services at 1-800-345-4109.

    Graco car seats typically last between 7 to 10 years, depending on the model and type: Infant Car Seats: Usually expire after 7 years from the date of manufacture.
